(rule!

(rule!
 ;; Overlay the 180-degree ROTATION onto the grid: every non-zero cell also
 ;; lands at its point-mirrored position.
 (overlay g (rotate-180 g)))

(rule!
 ;; Step A: count every present nonzero color and select the unique rarest.
 ;; Step B: preserve the input and echo only that selected color by a half-turn.
 (let* ((colors (filter (lambda (color) (> (count-color g color) 0))
                        (range 1 10)))
        (rarest (first
                 (sort colors
                       (lambda (left right)
                         (< (count-color g left)
                            (count-color g right)))))))
   (for*/fold ((out g))
              ((r (range 0 (rows g)))
               (c (range 0 (cols g))))
     (if (= (at g r c) rarest)
         (set-cell out
                   (- (rows g) 1 r)
                   (- (cols g) 1 c)
                   rarest)
         out))))
